Name: Tool bar Hotkey Labels
Author: Ericoshina
Description:
[color=#ffffff][font=sans-serif]本人完全不懂Mod要如何写，代码只能看懂if else while，这个Mod是用ChatGPT写的，我的作用是提出需求，让他输出代码，我去游戏里测试，反馈测试结果，让Mod的功能和我想要的一样。Mod适配了GMCM，并对GMCM配置菜单内容进行了汉化，当然，汉化也是让AI一起干的。[/font][/color]
[color=#ffffff][font=sans-serif]为了配合我的喜好，角标文字可以选择在工具栏的哪个角落（左上、左下、右上、右下），也可以输入值调整位置，可以通过输入颜色代码或名字来修改颜色，可以调整字体大小，设置是否需要阴影，以及大小写、组合键的缩写等。有新的需求或发现bug欢迎反馈。[/font][/color]
[color=#ffffff][size=3][font=sans-serif]Toolbar Hotkey Labels replaces Stardew Valley's fixed toolbar slot numbers with your actual current hotkeys. [/font][/size][/color][color=#ffffff][font=sans-serif]If you remap toolbar slots from originals to keys like Q/R/T, etc., this mod will display those keys directly on the toolbar, so the visual labels always match your control setup.[/font][/color]
[color=#ffffff][size=3][font=sans-serif]This mod was generated entirely with AI assistance. I defined the feature requirements, tested the mod in-game, and verified that the final release works as intended and matches the functionality I envisioned.[/font][/size][/color]

[color=#ffffff][font=sans-serif][b]Features[/b][/font][/color]
[color=#ffffff][font=sans-serif][b]------------[/b][/font][/color]
[list]
[*][color=#ffffff][size=3][font=sans-serif]Replaces the vanilla toolbar labels with your current inventory slot hotkeys [/font][/size][/color][/*]
[*][color=#ffffff][size=3][font=sans-serif]Supports custom keybinds instead of fixed number labels [/font][/size][/color][/*]
[*][color=#ffffff][size=3][font=sans-serif]Follows the toolbar correctly when it moves between the top and bottom of the screen [/font][/size][/color][/*]
[*][color=#ffffff][size=3][font=sans-serif]Hides the custom labels whenever the vanilla toolbar is not drawn[/font][/size][/color][/*]
[*][color=#ffffff][size=3][font=sans-serif]Configurable label size, color and anchor position[/font][/size][/color][/*]
[*][color=#ffffff][size=3][font=sans-serif]Configurable shadow, shadow color, and shadow offset[/font][/size][/color][/*]
[*][color=#ffffff][size=3][font=sans-serif]Supports different display styles for special keys:[/font][/size][/color]
[list]
[*][color=#ffffff][size=3][font=sans-serif] Short text [/font][/size][/color][/*]
[*][color=#ffffff][size=3][font=sans-serif]Full key names [/font][/size][/color][/*]
[*][color=#ffffff][size=3][font=sans-serif]Symbol style [/font][/size][/color][/*]
[/list][/*]
[*][color=#ffffff][size=3][font=sans-serif]Optional lowercase display for letter keys [/font][/size][/color][/*]
[*][color=#ffffff][size=3][font=sans-serif]Includes in-game configuration support through Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM), and a[/font][/size][/color][color=#ffffff][font=sans-serif]lso works without GMCM by editing config.json manually[/font][/color][/*]
[*][color=#ffffff][size=3][font=sans-serif]Includes English and Chinese localization for the config menu[/font][/size][/color][/*]
[/list][color=#ffffff][size=3][font=sans-serif][b]Requirements[/b][/font][/size][/color]
[color=#ffffff][size=3][font=sans-serif]------------------[/font][/size][/color]
[color=#ffffff][size=3][font=sans-serif]Required:[/font][/size][/color]
[list]
[*][color=#ffffff][size=3][font=sans-serif]SMAPI [/font][/size][/color][/*]
[*][color=#ffffff][size=3][font=sans-serif]Stardew Valley 1.6 [/font][/size][/color][/*]
[/list][color=#ffffff][size=3][font=sans-serif]Optional:[/font][/size][/color]
[list]
[*][color=#ffffff][size=3][font=sans-serif]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM) for in-game visual configuration [/font][/size][/color][/*]
[/list][color=#ffffff][font=sans-serif][size=3][b]Installation[/b][/size]
[size=3]--------------[/size][/font][/color]
[list=1]
[*][color=#ffffff][size=3][font=sans-serif]Install the latest version of SMAPI [/font][/size][/color][/*]
[*][color=#ffffff][size=3][font=sans-serif]Download this mod and extract the folder into [/font][/size][/color][color=#ffffff][font=sans-serif]your Stardew Valley mods folder[/font][/color][/*]
[*][color=#ffffff][size=3][font=sans-serif]Launch the game through SMAPI [/font][/size][/color][/*]
[/list][color=#ffffff][size=3][font=sans-serif][b]Configuration[/b]
--------------------[/font][/size][/color]
[color=#ffffff][size=3][font=sans-serif]This mod can be configured in two ways:[/font][/size][/color]
[list=1]
[*][color=#ffffff][font=sans-serif]Generic Mod Config Menu. [/font][/color][color=#ffffff][font=sans-serif]If you have GMCM installed, you can adjust the settings in-game.[/font][/color][/*]
[*][color=#ffffff][font=sans-serif]config.json. [/font][/color][color=#ffffff][font=sans-serif]If you do not use GMCM, launch the game once and the mod will generate config.json file automatically.[/font][/color][/*]
[/list][color=#ffffff][size=3][font=sans-serif]Configurable options include:[/font][/size][/color]
[list]
[*][color=#ffffff][size=3][font=sans-serif]Font scale [/font][/size][/color][/*]
[*][color=#ffffff][size=3][font=sans-serif]Text color [/font][/size][/color][/*]
[*][color=#ffffff][size=3][font=sans-serif]Shadow toggle [/font][/size][/color][/*]
[*][color=#ffffff][size=3][font=sans-serif]Shadow color [/font][/size][/color][/*]
[*][color=#ffffff][size=3][font=sans-serif]Shadow offset [/font][/size][/color][/*]
[*][color=#ffffff][size=3][font=sans-serif]Label anchor [/font][/size][/color][/*]
[*][color=#ffffff][size=3][font=sans-serif]Position fine-tuning [/font][/size][/color][/*]
[*][color=#ffffff][size=3][font=sans-serif]Special key display mode [/font][/size][/color][/*]
[*][color=#ffffff][size=3][font=sans-serif]Lowercase letter display [/font][/size][/color][/*]
[/list][color=#ffffff][size=3][font=sans-serif][b]Compatibility[/b][/font][/size][/color]
[color=#ffffff][size=3][font=sans-serif]------------------[/font][/size][/color]
[color=#ffffff][size=3][font=sans-serif]This mod is designed to work with Stardew Valley 1.6 and standard SMAPI setups. [/font][/size][/color][color=#ffffff][font=sans-serif]It has [/font][/color][color=#ffffff][font=sans-serif]not[/font][/color][color=#ffffff][font=sans-serif] been fully tested against other mods that directly change the toolbar or toolbar-related UI. [/font][/color][color=#ffffff][font=sans-serif]So far, the only toolbar-related compatibility I have specifically verified is with [/font][/color][color=#ffffff][font=sans-serif]Bigger Backpack[/font][/color][color=#ffffff][font=sans-serif]. [/font][/color][color=#ffffff][font=sans-serif]If you use other mods that modify the toolbar, HUD, or inventory UI, minor visual issues or compatibility problems may still be possible.[/font][/color]

[b][color=#ffffff][font=sans-serif]Notes[/font][/color][/b]
[color=#ffffff][size=3][font=sans-serif][b]--------[/b][/font][/size][/color]
[list]
[*][color=#ffffff][size=3][font=sans-serif]This mod only changes the toolbar label display [/font][/size][/color][/*]
[*][color=#ffffff][size=3][font=sans-serif]It does not change actual keybind behavior [/font][/size][/color][/*]
[*][color=#ffffff][size=3][font=sans-serif]It does not edit save data [/font][/size][/color][/*]
[*][color=#ffffff][size=3][font=sans-serif]It can be safely added to or removed from an existing save [/font][/size][/color][/*]
[/list][color=#ffffff][size=3][font=sans-serif][b]Why I made this[/b][/font][/size][/color]
[color=#ffffff][size=3][font=sans-serif][b]-----------------------[/b][/font][/size][/color]
[color=#ffffff][size=3][font=sans-serif]Stardew Valley allows toolbar hotkeys to be remapped, but the toolbar still shows the original fixed slot numbers. This mod makes the toolbar reflect the real hotkeys you are actually using, which makes custom control layouts much easier to read and remember.[/font][/size][/color]

Manifest.Name: Toolbar Hotkey Labels
Manifest.Description: Show current inventory-slot keybinds on the toolbar with configurable font, size, color, anchor, and bilingual GMCM support.
Manifest.Author: Ericoshina
